summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an expected amendment to its 2025 Form 20-F due to material weaknesses in internal controls over financial reporting. The company will adjust certain line items in its 2025 consolidated financial statements and amend Note 2 regarding prior period revisions. This is an accounting correction, not a special situation. The filing includes no M&A, restructuring, or corporate action. What to watch: regulatory scrutiny and any impact on financial reporting credibility.
